## Error
```
java.lang.IllegalStateException: The Activity class declared in your AndroidManifest.xml is wrong or has not provided the correct FlutterEngine.
  at com.ryanheise.audioservice.AudioServicePlugin$ClientInterface.onMethodCall(AudioServicePlugin.java:460)
```

```
PlatformException(The Activity class declared in your AndroidManifest.xml is wrong or has not provided the correct FlutterEngine...)
  at JustAudioBackground.init (just_audio_background.dart:54)
  at main (main.dart:13)
```

## Root Cause
`audio_service` (used by `just_audio_background`) requires `MainActivity` to extend `FlutterFragmentActivity` instead of `FlutterActivity`. The current `MainActivity.kt` extends `FlutterActivity`.

## Fix
Edit `/Users/akinpound/Documents/experiments/storia-mobile/storia_flutter/android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/storia/storia_flutter/MainActivity.kt`:

Change:
```kotlin
import io.flutter.embedding.android.FlutterActivity
class MainActivity : FlutterActivity()
```
To:
```kotlin
import io.flutter.embedding.android.FlutterFragmentActivity
class MainActivity : FlutterFragmentActivity()
```

That is the only change needed. Do NOT modify AndroidManifest.xml or any other files.
